conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Arjun Malhotra. Mera insurance premium ka payment fail ho raha hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Arjun ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap policy number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yeh hai I N S 4 5 6 7 8 9 1 2 3. Maine debit card se try kiya, lekin error aa raha hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main check karta hoon. Lagta hai payment gateway mein temporary issue hai. Kya aap UPI ya net banking se try kar sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Theek hai, main UPI try karta hoon. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Payment turant reflect hona chahiye. Agar phir bhi issue ho, toh mujhe dobara call karen. Aur koi madad?
